goal: Tell a short teamwork story: the situation, your task, what you did and the result, in simple past tense.

phrases.example: In my last project, we had one week to finish a report.
My task was to collect the data.

meaning.roman: Maine faisla kiya ke main ... karoon.

phrases.example: I decided to ask my teacher for more time.
As a result, we finished two days early.

roleplay.tutor_line: Tell me about a time you worked in a team.

task.roman: Ek team project ka mauqa batayein: kab tha aur kya tha.

roleplay.model_answer: In my last project at university, we had one week to finish a report. Our team had four people.

roleplay.tutor_line: What was your task in the team?

task.roman: Batayein ke aap ki zimmedari kya thi.

roleplay.model_answer: My task was to collect the data and write the first part of the report.

roleplay.tutor_line: Was there any problem? What did you do?

task.roman: Koi masla aaya? Aap ne kya kiya? Guzre hue waqt (past tense) mein batayein.

roleplay.model_answer: One member was ill, so we had less time. I decided to share his work with the team and I made a simple plan.
As a result, we finished the report one day early and our teacher liked our work.

roleplay.tutor_line: What did you learn from this experience?

task.roman: Batayein ke is tajurbe se aap ne kya seekha.

roleplay.model_answer: I learned that clear talk helps a team. In my next project, I will speak up earlier when there is a problem.

review_notes: The story follows Situation, Task, Action, Result in simple words. A learner with no group project may struggle. Should I add an alternative (a family or community event)?
